dimensions.holistic:
This dimension splits cleanly into two corpora with opposite health. The living program docs — the playbook §0.0.1 state ledger, COMPREHENSIVE_REVIEW_PROGRAM.md, the frozen DESIGN_*.md set, DEAD_CODE_DISPOSITION.md, the generated glossary — are the best succession documentation I have reviewed at any scale. I batch-verified ~120 commit hashes claimed by the ledger: every one exists, every lineage claim (ancestor vs off-lineage) is correct, and the quantitative claims match code exactly — CLOSURE_BUDGET_BYTES is 1_121_903 (ratchet #9's number to the byte), the any-cast baseline sums to 2,230 (the dead-code row's number), every DELETE in the dead-code disposition is gone from disk and every KEPT is present with its recorded reason. The five newest design docs were honored by their builds with unusual fidelity: promised kernels exist under the promised names (upswingKernel, resourceDynamicsKernel, momentum, navalKernel, settlementLifecycleKernel/FirstClass), promised verbs are in realmManifest, the lifecycle display genuinely shipped (SteadingsSection.jsx, PlacementsLayer.jsx), and deviations are recorded in-doc ("WHAT STAYS STALE, SAID OUT LOUD") or in ledger rows. The succession question — could a fresh AI resume from docs alone? — is a clear yes: the program doc's Round-2 section has phase checkboxes, per-phase death-recovery instructions, banked artifact paths, and verbatim owner rulings; it is current to within hours.

The failure mass sits in two places. First, the evergreen operator/contributor docs rotted through the same period the program docs excelled: DEPLOY.md — the canonical cutover runbook, on the critical path of the now-pre-authorized deploy — claims the tree "runs through 046" (actual: 134 migrations) and instructs deploying "10 functions total" when 16 exist, omitting verify-checkout-session, account-actions, and auth-recovery; ARCHITECTURE.md still contains zero mentions of the spatial engine (26 modules, the product's moat) and describes a 5-step gate when the real one is 10 steps including the constitutional verify:dist; CONTRIBUTING.md (50 lines) never mentions goldens, byte-identity, or the budget. These are round-1 findings (docs-knowledge-2/6/7/8/11) that no fix wave picked up, and each gap widened by fifteen waves. Second, the playbook's standing/desk sections re-rotted after W-DOCS-1 repaired them on 2026-07-13: §0.0.2's budget bullet, §0.0.3's NEXT pointer, §0.4's "CURRENT", and §0.8's priority list all describe the July-13 desk (M10b trim → W5) while the ledger rows above them describe the master merge opening. This is a genuine regression of fixed findings — and the root cause is structural: the fix duplicated volatile numbers instead of adopting its own recommended defer-to-the-ledger shape, so the sections rotted again within 48 hours. The mitigation is real (the NEXT pointer routes to the program doc, which is current; ledger rows are append-honest), so a successor is not lost, but they pay an hour of era-diffing and face two live traps: the round-21 plan still instructs cherry-picking W2 feed-retention "it will fit" into what is now an 85-byte margin, and two wave-state facts (W2's preserved-branch status, the calamity-ledger surface deferral) exist only in Claude memory, which the playbook itself declares non-transferable.

As product surface, the docs dimension matters because deploy and onboarding are imminently owner-executed paths; as process, the pattern is legible: this team's discipline concentrates where the constitution's machinery enforces it (ledger law, generated glossary, freshness pins) and decays exactly where no walker looks (DEPLOY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, standing prose sections). dimensions.holistic: Judged against its own four vision documents, this tree is the rare codebase whose ambition documents UNDERSELL it in places while its surfaces undersell the engine everywhere. The five-layer vision maps onto the shipped product like this. Layer 1 (the Forge) is complete to the letter short of speech: causally-ordered generation, receipts three deep, and the determinism promise literally on the landing page ("Same seed, same town. Every time." — the sample dossier forges the fixture's exact seed through the same action as every user generation). Layer 2 (the Clock) is now the product's crown and in several strata EXCEEDS the written vision: the v2 vision doc (2026-07-14) predates and never names six shipped systems — navies with the blockade-is-a-siege law, belief/decision momentum, settlement birth/death with relic-ruin scarcity, dynamic resource discovery/removal, foreign intervention with the mercenary clause, and the guidance/immersion layer. Layer 3 (the Covenant) is genuinely one trust model: the realm manifest's predicates wrap the sim's own wave gates so force ≡ organic holds by construction, the docket is mutable, the forecast is pinned preview≡apply, autonomy is dialed per domain; only branching/counterfactuals remain unmounted (recorded, owner-gated). Layer 4 (the Voice) has the best craft-per-surface I have seen in this repo — marketPrices renders the vision's own sentence ("four silver the bushel"), treatyDocument dresses every term's compliance strain in house voice — but coverage lags craft: the five newest ledgers are eyeless (registered), and this survey found three more unrecorded members of the same class, including the most literal one possible — warCausalBrief builds the vision's exact flagship line ("N of M peace reasons now present; this war is dying") and no surface renders it. Layer 5 (the Interpreter) is the honest bulk of the remaining distance: designed to the stud walls (DESIGN_AI_CONTROL_SURFACE, substrate audit row by row), deliberately substrated (operation registry + walker, aiGrounding, publicSafe projection twins, counterfactual kept for the branch mount), commercially specced ($19.99, BYOK, founder=30), and entirely unbuilt — correctly sequenced post-merge, and correctly NOT sold anywhere on the pricing page. The business ladder is truthful three rungs of four. Two structural caveats temper the grade. First, the composed 15-wave engine has never run its certification soak; the vision's behavioral promises (one great war and one golden age per decade, recovery as real as ruin, no stasis) are mechanically pinned (cacophony/upswing-recovery mini-soaks ride the gate) but empirically uncertified — deploy-un-soaked is owner-chosen and recorded, yet it means the product's most quotable claims are currently proofs of construction, not observation. Second, the vision corpus itself is aging non-uniformly: PRODUCT_COHERENCE (June 16) still lists gaps since fixed (the two-canon verbs now distinct in copy, the lifecycle dashboard now real) beside gaps never adjudicated (four consequence vocabularies, session-only pulse undo), and the canonical WHAT doc trails the engine by those six strata — for a program whose successors are told to start from the docs, the map should be redrawn to match the territory it conquered. Where does the product exceed ambition? Constitution-as-machinery (0 critical/0 constitutional findings, twice running), the counterpart criterion as enforced law, the Foundry module export, and Layer-4 craft. Where does it lag? The last read-model mile, the war-room PDF missing exactly its promised treaty table, the unnamed-empire read that would let a DM see — and baptize — the hegemony the topology already exhibits. The honest distance to "be good at everything, excel at the most important": one surfacing wave (largely enumerated already), Surveyor stages 1–2, the soak. B+ today; the path to A− is short, funded, and — unusually for ambition documents — already written down.
strengths: Layer-4 craft implements vision sentences nearly verbatim: marketPrices.js denominate() renders 'four silver the bushel' exactly as Layer 4 promises, endogeneity-safe by construction; treatyDocument.js gives every treaty term a house-voice compliance line ('the tribute is paid, but grudgingly')

The counterpart criterion is machinery, not doctrine: realmManifest.js predicates wrap the sim's own wave gates (peaceCausalActive, navalActive, momentumActive...) so force ≡ organic cannot drift, and unavailability teaches by naming its dark flags

The tree EXCEEDS the written vision in six shipped strata the v2 doc never names: navy + blockade-is-a-siege, momentum psychology, settlement lifecycle with relic-ruin scarcity, resource discovery/removal, foreign intervention + mercenary clause, the guidance/immersion layer

Layer-5 substrate laid deliberately ahead of the build: operationRegistry census + completeness walker, aiGrounding bundle, publicSafe projection twins, counterfactual.js preserved for the branch mount — the Surveyor lands on prepared ground, with zero vaporware sold on the pricing page meanwhile
The landing page keeps the vision's determinism promise live: the sample dossier forges its exact seed through the SAME forge action as every generation ('Same seed, same town. Every time.')

Constitutional fidelity under load: 0 critical and 0 constitutional violations across two full review rounds while 15 engine waves landed; first-paint budget ratcheted DOWN nine times (1,441,000 → 1,121,903)
